cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(PopPIMRamulator LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type")
set(YAML_CPP_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(YAML_CPP_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(YAML_CPP_BUILD_CONTRIB OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(YAML_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(ext/yaml-cpp yaml-cpp)
add_subdirectory(ext/spdlog spdlog)
include_directories(src ext/yaml-cpp/include ext/spdlog/include ext/argparse/include)
add_library(ramulator SHARED)
set_target_properties(ramulator PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib)
target_link_libraries(ramulator PUBLIC yaml-cpp spdlog)
add_executable(ramulator-exe)
target_link_libraries(ramulator-exe PRIVATE ramulator)
add_subdirectory(src)
